options: Two or more substances combine to form one product
One substance breaks into two or more products
optionsAf: Twee of meer stowwe kombineer om een produk te vorm
Een stof breek in twee of meer produkte
items.explain: Synthesis: A + B → AB, for example hydrogen and oxygen forming water.
items.explainAf: Sintese: A + B → AB, byvoorbeeld waterstof en suurstof wat water vorm.

items.q: Calcium carbonate heats up and breaks into calcium oxide and carbon dioxide. Which type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Kalsiumkarbonaat word verhit en breek in kalsiumoksied en koolstofdioksied. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: One compound breaks into two simpler products, so it is a decomposition reaction.
items.explainAf: Een verbinding breek in twee eenvoudiger produkte, dus is dit ’n ontbindingsreaksie.

items.q: Zinc is placed in copper sulfate solution and copper is deposited. Which type of reaction is this?
items.qAf: Sink word in kopersulfaatoplossing geplaas en koper word afgeset. Watter soort reaksie is dit?
items.explain: Zinc is more reactive than copper, so it displaces copper from the solution.
items.explainAf: Sink is reaktiewer as koper, so dit verplaas koper uit die oplossing.

items.q: What is needed for combustion (burning) of a fuel with oxygen?
items.qAf: Wat is nodig vir verbranding van ’n brandstof met suurstof?
items.explain: The fire triangle: fuel, oxygen and heat to start the reaction.
items.explainAf: Die vuurdriehoek: brandstof, suurstof en hitte om die reaksie te begin.

items.q: Balance the equation: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. How many water molecules are needed to balance it?
items.qAf: Balanseer die vergelyking: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. Hoeveel watermolekules is nodig om dit te balanseer?
items.explain: Two H₂O molecules use 4 hydrogen and 2 oxygen atoms, matching the reactants: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.
items.explainAf: Twee H₂O-molekule gebruik 4 waterstof- en 2 suurstofatome, wat by die reaktante pas: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.

items.q: Methane burns: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O. How many oxygen atoms are on each side?
items.qAf: Metaan brand: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O. Hoeveel suurstofatome is aan elke kant?
items.explain: Left: 2 × 2 = 4 O atoms. Right: 2 (in CO₂) + 2 (in 2H₂O) = 4 O atoms, so the equation is balanced.
items.explainAf: Links: 2 × 2 = 4 O-atome. Regs: 2 (in CO₂) + 2 (in 2H₂O) = 4 O-atome, dus is die vergelyking gebalanseer.
